{"consolidated_memory":"**HANG ON EXIT IN cli/commands/deploy.py — TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS**

Both incidents were in the developer tooling side of cli/commands/deploy.py, same code corner, but different root causes and fixes.

**INCIDENT 1 [2026-05-24]**
- Trigger: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Signal: Process finishes work but never returns
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #3327 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-1
- Result: Error rate dropped from 8.1% to under 6 per ten thousand (significant improvement)

**INCIDENT 2 [2026-07-27]**
- Trigger: Tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: Clock skew between two hosts
- Signal: Process finishes work but never returns
- Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
- PR #7867 on branch fix/hang-on-exit-2
- Result: Job finished in 32 minutes instead of 3 hours (900% improvement)

Both were reproduced by deploying the sample project and waiting. Context from earlier hang on exit work in the same component carried over to both fixes."}
